title: Calendar Block After a Host Cancellation — Roamhaven Listings
content:
# Calendar Block After a Host Cancellation

When the host cancels a confirmed stay on a Roamhaven Listings listing whose space type provides a host-cancellation block, every night of the cancelled stay is blocked on the listing's calendar, so the host cannot re-sell the same nights.

- The block starts on the stay's check-in date and ends on its check-out date (the day after the last blocked night).
- The block is placed once per cancelled stay; a stay already carrying a host-cancellation block on the listing receives no second block.
- The block is never lifted, by the host or by support.
- The block applies even when the host cancellation penalty is waived.

## Example (hypothetical stay)

A confirmed stay checks in on 2026-08-14 and checks out on 2026-08-18. The host cancels it. The calendar is blocked from 2026-08-14, the first blocked night, to 2026-08-18, the day after the last blocked night: the nights of 14, 15, 16 and 17 August cannot be re-sold. If the host's cancellation penalty is later waived, the block stays in place.
